title: Anticipation effects in DID: pre-announced policy

## 1. Identification Strategy

The research question investigates whether banks pre-emptively raise capital ratios between the announcement of a new minimum capital requirement (period 3) and its effective date (period 5). This scenario is perfectly suited for an **Event Study** analysis, which is an extension of the Difference-in-Differences (DID) framework.

**Methodology:**
We will implement an Event Study by estimating a panel regression model with bank-specific fixed effects ($\alpha_i$) and time-specific fixed effects ($\lambda_t$). The core of the model involves interacting a `treated` indicator (for banks below the capital threshold) with a set of time dummies, where time is measured relative to the policy's effective date.
